issues.description: In the template repository, the Bitmap24 class has an inconsistent API name: the header declares a method Bitmap24::write(const std::string&), but the implementation defines Bitmap24::save(const std::string&) and the example program calls bitmap.save(...). This causes compilation errors (no member named 'save' in Bitmap24) and prevents students from building/running the provided example program.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the Bitmap24 API consistent in the template: rename the declaration in example_program/src/Bitmap24.hpp from write(const std::string&) to save(const std::string&) to match Bitmap24.cpp and the call site in main.cpp (or alternatively rename the definition and all call sites to write).
